# UpgradeUX

> UpgradeUX is an independent digital agency specializing in custom web design, Next.js development, SEO, and digital transformation for startups and growing businesses.

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.upgradeux.in/services): Overview of digital services, technical capabilities, and web solutions.
- [Custom Website Development](https://www.upgradeux.in/services/custom-website): Bespoke web design and high-performance frontend engineering built with Next.js and React.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://www.upgradeux.in/services/search-engine-optimization): Technical, on-page, and structural SEO services to scale organic traffic.
- [Website Redesign](https://www.upgradeux.in/services/website-redesign): Complete digital overhaul of legacy websites focused on speed, modern UI/UX, and conversion.
- [WordPress Development](https://www.upgradeux.in/services/wordpress): Tailored, secure, and scalable WordPress development and custom themes.
